summary: M6-S1 is complete. Version 0.7 adds immutable project-local audit history, same-Profile baseline selection, deterministic regression classification, a native Chinese comparison view, two real Unreal report sessions, current documentation, and reproducible isolated host evidence.
evidence: Historical reports are stored by content hash and never overwritten; index corruption returns a localized diagnostic without deleting Reports
Comparison identity is asset_path plus rule_id, with separate new, persistent, resolved, and collection-failure categories
The native panel exposes a same-Profile baseline dropdown, manual comparison action, three result views, shared search, and session-folder access
The Demo runs a baseline asset variant and a current fault variant through the real UE 5.8.1 C++ collector before Python archives and compares the reports
The recorded comparison contains 10 new, 35 persistent, 6 resolved issues, and 2 persistent failures
UE_5.8.1-v0.7.0-dev1 BuildPlugin completed UHT, C++ compilation, linking, and Win64 packaging
UnrealAssetBatchAuditor.PanelEvidence passed in an independent hidden RenderOffscreen process and produced 12 current production Slate screenshots
The final lifecycle began and ended with no pre-existing or residual Unreal processes and records report, comparison, log, and screenshot hashes
Chinese README, Demo tutorial, video script, screenshot plan, development plan, and host test plan describe the workflow and evidence ceiling
unresolvedRisks: Visible mouse-click, docking, and cancellation interaction remains a manual recording step
Current panel execution is synchronous and must not be described as non-blocking
Comparison treats a rename or move as resolved old identity plus new current identity
Cross-version Unreal compatibility is not claimed
No asset mutation or automatic repair is authorized
